name: hotkey
title: Hotkey
description: Clicks or focuses an element when a keyboard shortcut is pressed anywhere on the page.

attributes.name: data-hotkey
attributes.description: The element to click or focus. It is its own root.

attributes.name: data-hotkey-action
attributes.description: A key filter on the document, e.g. "keydown.k@document->click" or "keydown.meta+k@document->focus".

notes: Shortcuts are ignored while the user types in an input or textarea, when another handler already called preventDefault(), and when the element has pointer-events: none (for example inside a closed sidebar).
Key filters: a–z, 0–9, enter, tab, esc, space, up, down, left, right, home, end, page_up and page_down, with optional ctrl+, meta+, alt+ and shift+ modifiers. Modifiers must match exactly.
